name: Cepatwawasan Group Berhad
overview: 今年集团的主要业务动态是出售 Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的 40% 股权，交易代价为 RM31,613,227，买方为集团间接持股 69.80% 的 Timah Resources Limited。其余公告主要为每月及每季的鲜果串、棕油和棕仁产量披露，以及股息与股东大会相关事项。
overview_en: The main business development this year was the disposal of a 40% equity interest in Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd. for a total consideration of RM31,613,227 to Timah Resources Limited, a 69.80% subsidiary of the group's wholly-owned Cash Nexus (M) Sdn. Bhd. Other announcements were mainly monthly and quarterly production disclosures of fresh fruit bunches, crude palm oil and palm kernel, as well as dividend and general meeting matters.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面的主要事项为出售 Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的 40% 股权。
segments.note_en: The main group-level event this year was the disposal of a 40% equity interest in Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Cash Nexus (M) Sdn. Bhd. 与 Timah Resources Limited 签订有条件股份买卖协议，出售 Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd. 23,500,000 股普通股（占 40% 股权），总代价 RM31,613,227。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Cash Nexus (M) Sdn. Bhd. entered into a conditional share sale agreement with Timah Resources Limited to dispose of 23,500,000 ordinary shares in Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd. (40% equity interest) for a total consideration of RM31,613,227.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 集团通过 Cash Nexus (M) Sdn. Bhd. 出售 Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的 40% 股权，交易完成后集团在 Cash Horse 的持股比例下降。
model_changes.text_en: The group, through Cash Nexus (M) Sdn. Bhd., disposed of a 40% equity interest in Cash Horse (M) Sdn. Bhd., reducing its shareholding in Cash Horse upon completion.
